items.title: Tributes paid to Tarling following British cyclist's death during Volta a Portugal
items.description: Tributes were paid to Finlay Tarling at the Volta a Portugal after the 19-year-old British cyclist died during the race on Friday.

items.title: St Helens keep slim play-off hopes alive by stunning Wakefield
items.description: St Helens produced a blistering second-half performance to stun Wakefield Trinity with a 46-16 victory and keep their slim Super League play-off hopes alive.

items.title: Celtic ease into League Cup quarters - Aberdeen, Kilmarnock & Ross Co also through
items.description: A round-up from the Scottish League Cup as Celtic eased through to the quarter-finals with 4-0 victory at Dundee United, Aberdeen beat Dundee, Kilmarnock won against Ayr United, while League One Ross County shocked Dunfermline.

items.title: Sunderland latest: Deal in principle agreed for Methalie
Sheff Utd & Birmingham draw a blank on opening day
items.description: Sheffield United and Birmingham made an underwhelming start to the Championship season as they played out a goalless draw at Bramall Lane.

items.title: Rashford returns as Amorim's Milan highlight issues for Carrick
items.description: Manchester United finish their pre-season campaign with a 4-2 defeat by Ruben Amorim's AC Milan in Poland, as Marcus Rashford returns to Red Devils action.

items.title: Championship excellent place to discover talent - Espanyol's Monchi
items.description: Espanyol sporting director Monchi explains why he believes England's Championship is an undervalued source of talent, and outlines his ambitions to restore Espanyol to the top end of Spanish football.

items.title: Rangers need 'wee bit of help' and money is there to get it
items.description: Rangers need "a wee bit of help" and have money to spend to get it despite dropping out of the Europa League, says manager Derek McInnes.

items.title: Pakistan win warm-up match ahead of England Test series
items.description: Pakistan warmed up for their first Test against England at Headingley from Wednesday with a seven-wicket win over a County Select XI as Saud Shakeel hit an unbeaten hundred and Imam-ul-Haq scored 80.

items.title: SunRisers, Super Giants out to deny Rockets a Hundred double
items.description: There could be a Trent Rockets double and a Sam Billings four-peat at Lord's on Sunday as the 2026 edition of The Hundred draws to a close.

items.title: Godolphin's Gold Cup hero Trawlerman retired
items.description: Trawlerman, winner of the Gold Cup at Ascot last year, has been retired after picking up an injury at Goodwood.
